title: Struct Holder
goal: A struct that holds a view into the poem - without owning or copying it.
hints: A struct field holding a reference makes the WHOLE struct lifetime-bound: Excerpt<'a>.
Owning (String) also compiles - if you pay for it. The poem is still needed afterwards.
explanation: Structs that hold references must declare it: Excerpt<'a> with a &'a str field ties every Excerpt to the data it views - that's E0106 waiting if you omit it. The borrowing version costs nothing and leaves poem usable. Owning versions also exist: moving poem in breaks the later println (E0382), and cloning works but buys a copy you didn't need. View-holding structs are everywhere in real Rust (parsers, iterators) - this shape is worth internalizing.
